description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ProtocolAdapterProvider used for runtime loading and configuration of protocol adapters within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for reflection-based instantiation, obtaining protocol adapters based on user agents, and managing header translation settings.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProvider
classes.description: Abstract class providing runtime loading of protocol adapters, configuration access, and header translation management.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProvider.Ignored
classes.description: Inner static class representing headers that are ignored by Ditto, implementing HeaderDefinition.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to load a ProtocolAdapterProvider instance via reflection based on configuration and actor system.

methods.name: getProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a ProtocolAdapter based on user agent string.

methods.name: getHttpHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Returns a HeaderTranslator for filtering incoming HTTP headers.

methods.name: createHttpHeaderTranslatorInstance
methods.description: Abstract method to create an instance of HeaderTranslator given protocol configuration.
